data.long_meaning: Shubh means auspicious, and Am means prosperity. The name Shubam is a combination of these two words and signifies a person who is blessed with good fortune and prosperity. The name Shubam carries the meaning “Auspicious, Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shubam usually hope their child will grow to embody auspicious, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Shubam is considered to be a sacred name in Hinduism, and it is believed that it brings good luck and prosperity to the person who bears it.
